anomalies.source: the weekly anomaly scan in gmarge/anomalies.py

provisional.note: ad spend, platform-attributed revenue, over-claimed revenue, over-claim ratio and blended reported ROAS are provisional until 2025-07-06: the days behind them are still filling in. No total, week-on-week change, ratio or channel comparison is computed for them and none appears in these FACTS, because a move measured across a lagging table is the lag, not a result. Do not describe, infer or explain one.

quality_findings.label: still filling in
quality_findings.description: ad_spend is still filling in over the last 2 days of the window, 2025-07-05 to 2025-07-06: the spend total stands at 82% on 2025-07-05 and 45% on 2025-07-06, against what the same weekday in the previous 4 weeks implies -- about $15,736 short of settled days. shopify_orders shows no such shortfall on the same days, so this is reporting lag rather than a real fall. Read these days as incomplete: a week-26 total built on them is understated, and any ratio that puts ad_spend against a complete table is distorted until they settle.

quality_findings.label: still filling in
quality_findings.description: ga4_sessions is still filling in over the last 2 days of the window, 2025-07-05 to 2025-07-06: the sessions total stands at 90% on 2025-07-05 and 60% on 2025-07-06, against what the same weekday in the previous 4 weeks implies -- about 18,654 sessions short of settled days. shopify_orders shows no such shortfall on the same days, so this is reporting lag rather than a real fall. Read these days as incomplete: a week-26 total built on them is understated, and any ratio that puts ga4_sessions against a complete table is distorted until they settle.

holdouts.note: A result is measured over the whole holdout window, not this week alone, and only exists once the window has closed. Incremental ROAS is what the channel is worth; reported ROAS is what the platform claims. Write an interval as 1.99x (90% interval 1.89x to 2.11x).

notes: Store revenue cannot be split by channel; platform-attributed revenue is not store revenue.
Reported ROAS is what the platforms claim. Only a holdout says what a channel is worth.
